'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Cambodia–Thailand relations]]
**[[2025 Cambodian–Thai border crisis]], [[Cambodian–Thai border dispute]]
***[[Cambodia]]n [[Prime Minister of Cambodia|prime minister]] [[Hun Manet]] accuses [[Thailand]] of shooting and killing a [[Cambodians|Cambodian]] villager near the [[Cambodia–Thailand border|border]], two days after a [[Royal Thai Army|Thai soldier]] was injured by a [[Land mines in Cambodia|land mine]] in the area, increasing tensions and threatening the [[ceasefire]] that put an end to the conflict in July. [https://apnews.com/article/thailand-cambodia-border-conflict-ceasefire-5b4c71e8bccb49520478e2b54e0ad640 (AP)]

'''Business and economy'''
*The [[United States]] [[United States Mint|Mint]] strikes its last [[penny (United States coin)|penny]] for circulation, though it will remain [[legal tender]]. There are still an estimated 300 billion pennies in circulation according to the [[U.S. Treasury Department|Treasury Department]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/bessent-us-treasurer-strike-final-penny-philadelphia-mint-2025-11-12/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Six people are killed in a [[stampede]] during a [[Ghana Armed Forces|military]] recruitment event in [[Accra]], [[Ghana]]. [https://apnews.com/article/ghana-stampede-military-recruitment-ffea0f78cdbc5f9e82dfb980b25f1a92 (AP)]
*At least 37 people are killed and 20 others are injured when a bus collides with a truck and crashes down a [[ravine]] in [[Arequipa Region|Arequipa]], [[Peru]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/peru-scores-killed-in-bus-accident-in-arequipa-region/a-74718783 (DW)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/11/13/at-least-37-people-killed-in-peru-when-bus-crashes-into-ravine (Al Jazeera)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Canada–Russia relations]], [[International sanctions during the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**During a [[G7]] meeting on the [[Russo-Ukrainian war]], [[Canada|Canadian]] [[Minister of Foreign Affairs (Canada)|foreign minister]] [[Anita Anand]] announces new [[Economic sanctions|sanctions]] targeting [[Russia]]n entities involved in [[Russo-Ukrainian cyberwarfare|cyberattacks]], drone production, [[Energy in Russia|energy infrastructure]], and the transport of [[Petroleum industry in Russia|oil]] via the [[Russian shadow fleet|shadow fleet]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/world/2025/11/12/g7-ministers-discuss-ukraine-support-as-canada-unveils-new-russia-sanctions (AFP via Al Arabiya)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Corruption in Ukraine]]
**[[Operation Midas]]
***[[Ukraine|Ukrainian]] [[Ministry of Justice (Ukraine)|justice minister]] [[German Galushchenko]] and [[Ministry of Energy (Ukraine)|energy minister]] [[Svitlana Hrynchuk]] resign following a [[National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine|National Anti-Corruption Bureau]] investigation into an alleged [[Kickback (finance)|kickback]] scheme involving Ukraine's [[Energy in Ukraine|nuclear power plant]] operator [[Energoatom]]. The alleged head of the corruption group, [[Tymur Mindych]], has fled Ukraine. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2025/nov/12/zelenskyy-fires-ministers-accused-of-involvement-in-bribery-scheme-as-public-outrage-grows (''The Guardian'')]
*[[Ethiopian Airlines Flight 302]]
**A [[Juries in the United States|U.S. federal jury]] orders [[Boeing]] to pay [[United States dollar|$]]28.45 million in [[damages]] to the family of Shikha Garg, a victim of the 2019 [[Ethiopian Airlines]] [[Boeing 737 MAX|737 MAX]] crash, marking the first civil trial verdict related to [[Boeing 737 MAX#Accidents and incidents|the two fatal MAX accidents]]. [https://www.bhpioneer.com/news/national_world_news/us-jury-boeing-owes-28-mn-to-family-of-ethiopian-airlines-crash-victim/article_7ea741ee-7cfe-501f-b2a5-d7ca3eab4f59.html (AFP via ''Black Hills Pioneer'')]
*[[Crime in Germany]]
**An 18-year-old is sentenced to eight years and nine months in prison for a shooting at a bar in [[Göppingen]], [[Baden-Württemberg]], Germany, that killed one person and injured two others in 2024. [https://nordot.app/1361324445139845498 (Deutsche Presse-Agentur)]
*Two [[Hellenic Police|police officers]] are injured and 29 people are arrested when a riot breaks out at a [[immigration detention]] site in [[Sintiki]], [[Serres (regional unit)|Serres]], [[Greece]]. [https://apnews.com/article/migration-greece-riot-crete-eu-fb9fdcea1b5cfc9fc6fdf0c7eef21d27 (AP)]

**A [[Bill (United States Congress)|bill]] passes through [[United States Congress|Congress]] and is signed by [[United States President|president]] [[Donald Trump]], ending the longest [[Government shutdowns in the United States|government shutdown]] in American history at 43 days.
